data.gender_notes: Kamalkant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamalkant is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Kamal' (lotus) and 'Kant' (God). It refers to the God who resides in the lotus flower. In Hindu mythology, Kamalkant is often depicted as Vishnu or Krishna holding a lotus flower. The name Kamalkant carries the meaning “God of lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamalkant usually hope their child will grow to embody god of lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamalkant total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Lotus flowers are frequently used in religious art and cultural ceremonies, symbolizing purity, creation, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kamalkant signifies the divine and eternal presence of a deity within the natural world, especially in its most beautiful and pure forms.
